Mononoke The Movie: Chapter Ⅲ - The Curse of the Serpent | Official Trailer #2 | Netflix Anime
The stage is set for the final story in the Mononoke trilogy. As the Medicine Seller faces down a new foe, follow the tale of the official consort, Lady Yukiko, to uncover the Form, Truth, and Reason needed to put it to rest.

🎵 Theme song: "No Epilogue" by AiNA THE END

Mononoke The Movie: Chapter Ⅲ - The Curse of the Serpent comes exclusively to Netflix, premiering worldwide on September 29!
